caption: The rules: every rule of the vault with its severity, check and class; an open rule shows its source, its version, its text and the check it comes with.
Coverage by family: how many rules have a check that runs by itself, how many are a question for an agent, and how many stay manual.
The sources: the rule sets of the vault and the class of each one, public, internal or private, which decides what may leave the hub.
